articles.summary: AUSTIN, Texas, March 11, 2025 -- As the Trump administration reconsiders the role and scope of the federal government, many Americans are ready to rethink the way healthcare works in the United States, according to new research from eHealth, Inc. (Nasdaq: EHTH), a leading online private health insurance marketplace...
articles.title: New eHealth Research Finds Americans are Unhappy with the US Healthcare System and Open to New Ideas
